title: Everything Is Slow (and the Disk Alert Is Firing Too)
symptom: Every request to this server takes seconds instead of milliseconds, and — separately, or maybe not — the root filesystem alert started firing this morning. You have one shift to sort out both.

goals.description: Load average is below the number of CPUs
The root filesystem is below 80% used
The worker service is still running

question.prompt: What was making every request slow?
options: The full disk was slowing all I/O
A report script was pegging every CPU core
Network latency to the load balancer

debrief: Two unrelated problems at once — the realistic kind. Load average far above nproc plus 'ps --sort=-%cpu' pointed at a report script running '--all-time' on every core; the disk alert was the worker's runaway debug log again. The trap is assuming one root cause for every symptom: fixing only the disk would have left everything slow. Triage each symptom to its own evidence. Longer term: run heavy reports on a separate box (or at least with 'nice'), and set CPU and log-size limits so one job can't starve the rest.
